purpose: Identify robust long-term baseline mechanisms before doing any further specialist, interrupt, or router work.

design.non_overlap_rule: Primary cross-era conclusions compare the prehistory discovery partition ending 2010-12-31 with the modern dataset beginning 2011-01-03. Prehistory holdout rows from 2011-2012 remain audit outputs but are excluded from the primary cross-era replication claim.
design.comparison_rule: All mechanisms use synchronized dates, causal market-state labels, execution assumptions, and costs within each era. Whole-period and rolling evidence determine baseline robustness; state-level results remain diagnostic and cannot authorize routing.
design.selection_rule: The roster represents distinct mechanisms rather than parameter variants. No strategy may be removed, retuned, or promoted after inspecting Phase 010 outputs.

frozen_roster.mechanism: static equity, Treasury, and gold allocation
inverse-volatility equity, Treasury, and gold balance
static equity, Treasury, gold, and commodity allocation
absolute and relative momentum across liquid asset classes
relative momentum with an explicit defensive fallback

interpretation_rule: A passing mechanism becomes a candidate for another frozen validation phase. Phase 010 cannot activate a router, change paper trading, or authorize live capital.
